issues.reason: (Member sk_subgroup_1 subgroup) types one individual as a subgroup where the text has several, and a plural referred to as a unit takes a group witness with (GroupOf <group> <kind>) — the parse records a count of subgroups the sentence does not state.

The performers are the students, and with no symbol for them the parse hands the performance to the subgroup entity by Possession while dropping the stated "in" relation — a misattributed possessor plus a lost link, not merely an unexpressed one.

CardinalityPhrase records the size of the group it is attached to, so on a group whose members are students it says the students are "various" — a quantity claim on the wrong set, since "various" counts the subgroups.

"Such as race" is exemplification, for which the instruction set offers no head or construction (the reviewer's own gap), and inventing one — or asserting (Inheritance race subgroup) — would put unlicensed content in the KB, so dropping it is correct.

gaps_confirmed: exemplification appositive "N, such as X" — no licensed head or construction
"various" as a vague plural quantifier — neither a proportion word nor one of the listed CardinalityPhrase count phrases
sentence-initial adversative "But" whose other endpoint lies outside the sentence — the connective rule requires two in-text clauses
new_gaps: a bare plural in an of-genitive ("the performance of students") — group witness vs bare kind constant is unspecified, the same gap as bare plurals in oblique position

a non-locative categorial "in" between entities ("students in various subgroups") — LocatedIn is containment-only and physical, PartOf's group-membership job is about individuals in a group, so the repair uses the preposition-named `In` oblique on the framing-PP precedent
repair_summary: Replaced (Member sk_subgroup_1 subgroup) + (GroupOf sk_subgroup_1 student) with (GroupOf sk_subgroup_1 subgroup) so the plural is a group of subgroups; added (GroupOf sk_students_1 student) for the students; moved the "various" CardinalityPhrase onto the subgroups group (unchanged symbol); linked the two with (In sk_students_1 sk_subgroup_1); repointed Possession from the subgroups to sk_students_1. The push clause and the Act atoms are untouched.
notes: The main clause was already correct — inanimate transitive subject as Agent, Theme + Goal with no Result, the compound list genus, and the named Act typed, propertied and named.
